_readme: Level 1 Living Plaza (Documentation/Level1LivingPlaza). Read by PlazaLifeContent; a missing or broken file falls back to a short built-in line.
npcs: the four ambient townspeople. id must match AmbientNpcInteractable.ambientId in Office_Level1. name is what the dialogue box shows.
role / background / attitude are notes for writers (not shown in game).

talks: each tap plays the next talk (it wraps around), so a talk is short (1-4 lines). speaker is Npc or Player; emote is an optional tag (heart, sparkles, alert, question, thinking, idea, sweat, worried, annoyed, music).
Ambient talk is flavour only: it never gives a profile, ID, EXP, coins or progress. Keep it everyday (receipts, prices, small business), never a lecture, and never name a taxpayer classification.
marieTravel: Marie's one line if you tap her while she walks to the office (toOffice), waits at the front desk (atReception) or walks to the conference room (toRoom).

npcs.name: Aling Lorna
npcs.role: Sari-sari store owner, shopping at the Supply Counter
npcs.background: Runs a small store two streets from the plaza and restocks her receipt booklets and ledger here every few months. Writes everything down.

lines.speaker: Npc
lines.text: Sorry, sorry, I'm counting my change. Busy morning!

lines.speaker: Npc
lines.text: My store's receipt booklet ran out. I write one for every sale, even a sachet of coffee.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: Even for the small sales?

lines.speaker: Npc
lines.text: Especially those! At month's end I know exactly where my money went.

lines.speaker: Npc
lines.text: Ballpens went up by two pesos. Two!

lines.speaker: Npc
lines.text: Good thing I keep every supplier receipt in one folder. One look and I know my real costs.

lines.speaker: Npc
lines.text: Still choosing a ledger. The thick one lasts the whole year.

lines.speaker: Npc
lines.text: Sige, I need to get back before the afternoon rush. My suki will be waiting!

npcs.name: Mang Dante
npcs.role: Security guard of the office building, patrolling the front
npcs.background: Has guarded the building for twelve years. Knows every regular by face and keeps a visitor logbook out of habit.

lines.speaker: Npc
lines.text: Good day.

lines.speaker: Npc
lines.text: Just keeping an eye on the plaza.

lines.speaker: Npc
lines.text: Quiet morning. That's how I like it.

lines.speaker: Npc
lines.text: Hm? I write down everyone who comes and goes. Old habit.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: Even me?

lines.speaker: Npc
lines.text: Even you.

npcs.name: Bea
npcs.role: Freelance graphic artist, catching up with her cousin Carlo
npcs.background: Designs logos and menus for small shops around town. Recently started tracking her client payments after losing count last year.

lines.speaker: Npc
lines.text: Hi! Don't mind us, we're just catching up.

lines.speaker: Npc
lines.text: Three clients paid me for their logos this month. Finally!

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: Congratulations!

lines.speaker: Npc
lines.text: Salamat! I list every payment in a little notebook now, so nothing slips through.

lines.speaker: Npc
lines.text: Carlo says I spend too much on milk tea. He's not wrong.

lines.speaker: Npc
lines.text: I keep my receipts in an envelope now. Seeing the total is a little scary!

lines.speaker: Npc
lines.text: The plaza's always lively this time of day.

lines.speaker: Npc
lines.text: Good luck with whatever you're working on!

npcs.name: Carlo
npcs.role: Delivery rider on his break, resting on the bench with Bea
npcs.background: Rides deliveries for a few shops since six in the morning. Tired, a little short with strangers, softer than he sounds.

lines.speaker: Npc
lines.text: Hm? We're kind of in the middle of something.

lines.speaker: Npc
lines.text: ...Fine. I'm on my break. Deliveries since six this morning.

lines.speaker: Npc
lines.text: Gas went up again. Half of what I earn goes into the motorbike.

lines.speaker: Npc
lines.text: Bea keeps telling me to write it all down. Maybe she has a point.

lines.speaker: Npc
lines.text: You again? Okay, okay. Have a good one.

toOffice.speaker: Npc
toOffice.text: Oh, hi! I'm heading to your office now. See you inside!

atReception.speaker: Npc
atReception.text: I'm just checking in at the front desk. Go ahead, she's expecting you.

toRoom.speaker: Npc
toRoom.text: I'll wait for you in the conference room!
